sections.text_helper: Section 16.1.29 "SYSCFG AHB write posting address error register (SYSCFG_AHBWP_ERROR_SR)" in chapter 16 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 826.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x104
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset by system reset.
Bits 31:0 PAHB_ERROR_ADDR[31:0]: Reports address of the first error in P-AHB write-posting buffer
